title: 第一卷 第24章 神兵天降，遍地开花！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
创生莲华界，炎阳仙舟之上。

    姜无痕站在仙舟前方，负手而立，俯瞰下方化作人间炼狱的三生阁。

    上万邪修掌控着十几万头尸傀，冲破了三生阁内的层层防线，肆意残杀、啃食着阁中弟子。

    甚至，不少邪修看到年轻貌美的女弟子，在这满地狼藉的战场之上，实施暴行。

    邪修和尸傀所过之处，犹如蝗虫过境，满是衣不蔽体的断臂残躯……

    他们的修为虽不高，但这般残酷血腥的场面，却是让姜家众人面露难色。

    沐凝薇、姜纤纤几个女孩子，忍不住直接吐了出来。

    “此处虽场面血腥，但好在……出云宗尚未得手，安家姐妹依旧是完璧之身。”姜清濯站在姜无痕身旁，开口劝道，“无痕，你先回仙舟内部等着，这里交给我们……”

    话还没说完，姜无痕突然注意到，一位化龙境的女邪修脚踏一颗灵兵级别的水晶骷髅头，身边禁锢着安兮兮，从三生阁的战圈中离去。

    他一眼就认出了安兮兮，二话不说，提着极道人皇幡就冲了过去。

    这般举动，把姜家众人吓了一跳。

    “快，保护帝子！”

    姜清濯当即喊道。

    与此同时，姜无痕踏空而来，拦在了出云宗那位女长老面前。后者感受到姜无痕周身散发出的化龙境巅峰气息，不由得心头一惊。

    “你是何人？敢管出云宗的闲事！”女长老打量着姜无痕，沉声威胁道，“我乃出云宗十二‘天尸长老’之一的苏羽鸢，我们宗主就在附近，不想死的……赶紧滚开！”

    “聒噪！”

    姜无痕冷哼，手腕一转，极道人皇幡撕裂出恐怖的罡气，直接将苏羽鸢连同她脚下的水晶骷髅灵兵斩为两段。

    苏羽鸢，身死道消！

    残躯坠落，而她身边的安兮兮并无御空手段，直直掉了下去。

    就在她即将坠地时，姜无痕御空而来，一把将她抱住，安稳的放在了地上。

    “没事吧？”

    姜无痕低头看着她，淡然道。

    安兮兮小嘴微张，惊讶的望着这位如神兵天降的黑衣少年，怔怔的出神。

    “别发呆了，你姐姐呢？”

    姜无痕捏了捏她的小脸，追问道。

    安兮兮这才回过神来，连忙指着远处的大殿，迫不及待的喊道：“在‘三生殿’，出云宗的伊老魔也在。只要你能救我姐姐，我愿为你做任何事……”

    “跟我走！”

    姜无痕神色凝重，一把抱起安兮兮，冲向三生殿。

    战场混乱，不少邪修注意到姜无痕和安兮兮，数万尸傀，围攻向二人。

    “少侠，当心！”

    安兮兮花容失色，连忙出言提醒。
content_en:
Create the Lotus Realm, above the Flame Sun Immortal Boat.

Jiang Wuhen stood in front of the immortal boat, with his hands behind his hands, overlooking the Sansheng Pavilion below, which had turned into a human purgatory.

Tens of thousands of evil cultivators controlled hundreds of thousands of corpse puppets, breaking through the layers of defense in Sansheng Pavilion, killing and eating the disciples in the pavilion wantonly.

Many evil cultivators even saw young and beautiful female disciples committing atrocities on this messy battlefield.

Wherever the evil cultivators and corpse puppets passed, they were like locusts passing by, filled with naked and broken limbs...

Although their cultivation level was not high, such a cruel and bloody scene made everyone in the Jiang family look embarrassed.

The girls Mu Ningwei and Jiang Xianxian couldn't help but vomited it out.

"Although the scene here is bloody, fortunately...the Izumo Sect has not succeeded yet, and the An family sisters are still in perfect condition." Jiang Qingzhuo stood beside Jiang Wuhen and advised, "Wuhen, you go back to the fairy boat first and wait, leave this place to us..."

Before he finished speaking, Jiang Wuhen suddenly noticed that a female evil cultivator in the Dragon Transformation Realm stepped on a crystal skull of the level of a spiritual soldier, and left the battle circle of Sansheng Pavilion with An Xixi imprisoned beside her.

He recognized An Xixi at a glance, and without saying a word, he rushed over holding the Jidao Human Emperor flag.

This behavior shocked everyone in the Jiang family.

"Quick, protect the emperor!"

Jiang Qingzhuo shouted immediately.

At the same time, Jiang Wuhen came through the air and stopped in front of the female elder of the Izumo Sect.The latter felt the aura of the Peak Dragon Transformation Realm emanating from Jiang Wuhen's body, and couldn't help but feel shocked.

"Who are you? Dare to meddle in the Izuyun Sect's business!" The female elder looked at Jiang Wuhen and threatened in a deep voice, "I am Su Yuyuan, one of the twelve 'Heavenly Corpse Elders' of the Izuyun Sect. Our sect master is nearby. If you don't want to die... get out of here!"

"Noisy!"

Jiang Wuhen snorted, and with a twist of his wrist, the Jidao Human Emperor Banner tore out terrifying energy, directly cutting Su Yuyuan and the Crystal Skeleton Spirit Soldier at her feet into two pieces.

Su Yuyuan is dead!

The broken body fell, and An Xixi beside her had no means of controlling the air and fell straight down.

Just when she was about to fall to the ground, Jiang Wuhen came from the air, hugged her, and placed her safely on the ground.

"Are you okay?"

Jiang Wuhen looked down at her and said calmly.

An Xixi opened her mouth slightly, looking at the young man in black who looked like a divine soldier descending from the sky in surprise, and was in a daze.

"Don't be dazed. Where is your sister?"

Jiang Wuhen pinched her little face and asked.

Only then did An Xixi come back to her senses. She quickly pointed to the main hall in the distance and shouted impatiently: "In the 'Sansheng Hall', Yi Laomo from the Izumo Sect is also there. As long as you can save my sister, I am willing to do anything for you..."

"Follow me!"

Jiang Wuhen looked solemn, picked up An Xixi, and rushed towards Sansheng Hall.

The battlefield was chaotic. Many evil cultivators noticed Jiang Wuhen and An Xixi. Tens of thousands of zombies surrounded them.

"Young hero, be careful!"

An Xixi's beauty turned pale, and she quickly spoke out to remind her.
